rule: the confirmation run of whole-film/3 (owner ruling, 5 Nov 2026, spec §17.15): SC1-1a's exact films, folds, seeds and plants judged by whole-film/3, printed beside whole-film/1 (SC1-1a's own rule). Not a test.
spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-03-sc1-whole-film-check-design.md §17.15 (and §17.6, owner ruling R1b-5); plan Task E
header: development films, tuned on (R1b-5); not a test
disclosure: These are SC1-1a's spent films (Ceph-400 Test1 151-300 and Aariz valid). They are development films, tuned on by the owner's ruling R1b-5: every number below is in-sample.

This is the THIRD tuning on these same films: gate /3, then the size and centre lines, then the owner's whole-film/3 ruling (maxilla and mandible tolerances back to 0.02; centre line 0.08), which was chosen after seeing the decomposition on these films.

The size look's line and the centre median were set on these films among the 520 calibration films, so their false alarms here are zero by construction (the ruled centre line 0.08 is wider than the measured worst, 0.0584).

The shape look's 1,000-tracing reference holds the Ceph-400 Test1 tracings (as ceph400:NNN); each Test1 film is judged with its whole fold's names left out. Aariz valid films are not in the reference and use it whole.
Only SC1-1b-PKU (Task F) measures whole-film/3 on films it has never seen. This run cannot replace it.

films.aariz: valid (150), 98 of them with a scale under aariz-scale/1
films.refused: Ceph-400 test2, Aariz test and PKU (sealed), before anything is read

folds: Test1 ids sorted, shuffled with splitmix64 seed 20261103; fold i = positions 30i..30i+29 (5 folds); a Test1 film is judged by the 150 Train tracings plus the other four folds (270); Aariz valid films by all 300

seeds.note: SC1-1a's seeds; plants made by sc1_1a::plants and sc1_1a::info_shifts unchanged (p4_draw = p4_draw_seeded(20261104, ...))

plants.rng: ft_common::case_rng(20261104, [type, film index, part]); P2's derangement: chainproof::Rng(20261104 ^ dataset salt)
plants.P1a: mirrored with the film: x -> width - 1 - x, the film's facing unchanged; 300
plants.P1b: mirrored in place about the tracing's centroid; 300
plants.P2: another film's tracing, coordinates as they are: a seeded single-cycle derangement within the same Test1 fold (so the planted tracing is never in the judged film's reference set) and within Aariz valid; 300
plants.P3: x0.5 and x2 about the tracing's centroid; 600
plants.P4: each of the 5 regions in turn, all its traced points moved d = 10 + 10u mm in direction 2*pi*v (u, v from the case rng); films with a recorded scale only: Ceph-400 test1 at 0.1 mm/px (150) and Aariz valid under aariz-scale/1 (98); 1,240

plantNote: verbatim SC1-1a's (reference/sc1-1a.json plants and definitions). P4's direction is already random: a uniform angle 2*pi*v per film and region from the case rng; nothing in the plants is changed

definitions.facing: every film's stored facing is right (facing_left false), as in the gate and the region probe; the check is called exactly as the app calls it
definitions.filmIndex: Test1 ids sorted are film indices 0-149; Aariz valid ids sorted are 150-299
definitions.types: case-rng type numbers: P4 5 (part = region index in the canonical order cranial base, maxilla, mandible, incisors, soft-tissue profile), the information shift 6 (part = 10 or 20, the shift in mm), the control films 9
definitions.draws: P4: u = (next >> 11) / 2^53 from the case rng, then the direction from ft_common::direction on the same stream (one number: angle 2*pi*v); the information shift: the direction only
definitions.centroid: the mean of the 19 traced points; P1b: x -> 2 cx - x; P3 and C2: p -> c + k (p - c); C8: each coordinate x1000 (about the film's origin)
definitions.mm: a shift of d mm is d / mm-per-px pixels: 0.1 mm/px on Ceph-400, the aariz-scale/1 value on an Aariz valid film; the check never reads it
definitions.salts: P2's dataset salt: 400 + fold index (0-4) for a Ceph-400 Test1 fold (one derangement per fold, over the fold's ids in fold order); 1 for Aariz valid (over its ids sorted). Sattolo: for i from n-1 down to 1, swap i with Rng.below(i)
definitions.boxes: the region finder runs once per film on the film as stored (cached by detector fingerprint, reports/sc1/boxes); every plant of a film is judged against that film's boxes at the score line; C4's 10 films are run again flipped, and their facing read in the flipped film
definitions.C1: reference: ceph_model synthetic faces(300, seed 20261103); judged: faces(50, seed 20261104) on a 2000 x 2400 SYNTHETIC film, mirrored x -> 1999 - x; shape look only (no region model); 'mirrored' = the reason mirrored
definitions.C3: forward = +x (the films face right); 40 mm = 400 px at Ceph-400's 0.1 mm/px
definitions.stageA: point-check/2 score_run with a ShapeScorer of the same reference tracings (fold-held-out on Test1); flagged = Flagged or FilmUnusual; information only
definitions.caught: flagged = the whole-film check's result is Flagged (any reason); Clean and NotRun are not flagged

v1.name: whole-film/1 (SC1-1a's rule exactly)
v1.shape: models/shape/ceph400-v1.shape (300 tracings), each Test1 film judged by the 270 outside its fold (sc1_1a::Refs), Aariz valid by all 300
v1.tau: gate /2: models/regions/calibration-2.json (kept byte for byte by gate /3), checked by sc1_1a::check_calibration against SC1-1a's pins (rule sc1-box-gate/2, cranial base 0.09, maxilla 0.02, mandible 0.02, incisors 0.01, soft tissue 0.10, gate report db1a67a0...eae7, score line 0.50)
v1.looks: shape, regions, facing; no size, no centre
v1.judged: sc1_1a::judge_all (Stage A for information, as SC1-1a)

v2.name: whole-film/3
v2.tau: sc1-box-gate/4 (owner ruling): models/regions/calibration.json with rule sc1-box-gate/4, gateReportSha256 = reference/sc1-box-gate-4.json's SHA-256 (pinned below), its tau equal to that record's (cranial base 0.09, maxilla 0.02, mandible 0.02, incisors 0.01, soft tissue 0.10)
v2.size: models/regions/size-calibration.json (sc1-size/1), unchanged, its report SHA-256 pinned below
v2.centre: models/regions/cb-centre-calibration.json: the measured median (report pinned below) with the ruled line 0.08; its ruling field names reference/sc1-cb-centre-ruling.json (SHA-256 pinned below)
v2.judged: sc1_1a::check_with(film, tracing, scorer, FilmCal { tau /4, size, centre at 0.08 })

columns.refuse: the /1 column refuses a calibration that is not gate /2's; the whole-film/3 column refuses one that is not sc1-box-gate/4's, and a centre calibration without the ruling

pins.sc1aPins: reference/sc1-1a.json regions (the /1 column's calibration and gate report)

printed: the header line, with the words 'development films, tuned on (R1b-5); not a test'
per planted kind (P1a, P1b, P2, P3 x0.5, P3 x2, P4 by region): /1 caught beside /2 caught, of N, and the change

per kind and column, which look flagged (a case may have several): mirrored, shape, region (a point past its edge), size, centre (the cranial-base centre), facing, no-ceph-found; and, for /2, how many were flagged ONLY by the size or centre look
untouched (N) by dataset, /1 beside /2, with the same per-look counts
POOLED: caught of 2,740 and untouched flagged of 300, each with its exact (Clopper-Pearson) 95% interval, for both columns
information: the whole tracing moved 10 and 20 mm (films with a scale), /1 beside /2

information.centreLineSensitivity: the whole-film/3 pooled catch and untouched-flag counts re-judged with the centre line at 0.06 (measured), 0.08 (ruled) and 0.10, in memory only; every other number fixed. The 0.06 row is the decomposition's row 2 configuration
information.centreMedians: per-set median centre offsets (nearest rank per axis): Ceph-400 Test1 and Aariz valid from this run's untouched tracings, and all four calibration sets (hold-out, Ceph-400 Train, Ceph-400 Test1, Aariz valid) from reports/sc1/cb-centre-calibration.json (its SHA-256 pinned above)

controls.P0: the /1 column's counts (every line and both totals) equal SC1-1a's report reports/sc1/sc1-1a.json (SHA-256 pinned above) field for field: 2,289 of 2,740 caught, 11 of 300 untouched flagged. If not, the instrument is not SC1-1a's: broken (exit 1), report still written and printed
controls.C7: every count equals its expected total in both columns (sc1_1a::count with SC1-1a's marks)
controls.homework: a Test1 film judged by a reference holding its own tracing under either name (151 or ceph400:151) is refused
controls.centreAtCalibratedLine: re-judging at the ruled centre line 0.08 gives the main whole-film/3 counts
controls.row2: the 0.06 sensitivity row (gate /2's tolerances, the 1,000 reference, the measured centre line) reproduces the decomposition's row 2 exactly: 2,650 of 2,740 caught, 5 of 300 untouched flagged (reports/sc1/sc1-1b-dev-decompose.json, SHA-256 pinned above). If not, broken (exit 1)

stop: whole-film/3 below 2,603 of 2,740 caught, or above 6 of 300 untouched flagged -> exit 3: stop and report to the owner before PKU is pre-registered. No further re-tuning on these films

verdicts.printed: controls hold and the stop not tripped -> exit 0
verdicts.stop: controls hold and the stop tripped -> exit 3
verdicts.broken: a pin, a refusal, a count or a control fails -> exit 1
